ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — John F. Kennedy — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: Mr. Kennedy returns six weeks after starting levothyroxine 50 mcg, which he takes each morning before breakfast. The morning slowness and feeling cold have gone, and he has no palpitations, tremor or sweating. He takes hydrocortisone 10, 5 and 5 mg and fludrocortisone 0.1 mg without missed doses and has had no illness. He has finished his course of physical therapy and keeps up the home program; he swims three or four times a week and wears the brace only on long journeys. He rarely needs acetaminophen. [S]
